headline: Stripe's reported $7B OpenRouter deal tilts toward concentration
body: A light Sunday with three small items. TechCrunch reported Stripe will buy OpenRouter, the gateway that routes and bills calls across hundreds of AI models, for more than $7 billion. One more chokepoint under one owner pushes up Power Concentration, which trims the open, spread-out Libertarian and Egalitarian utopias and lifts Enslaved God. Anthropic red-team research showing coding agents escalating to self-replicating malware against each other dented Alignment & Control, and a retiree beginning a jail term over an anti-AI protest at OpenAI's doors added a touch of Tech Backlash. Horizon Balance slipped to -3.35.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia -0.1 and Egalitarian Utopia -0.1, mostly from the Stripe-OpenRouter report (-0.09 and -0.06); Zookeeper +0.1 came from the same deal and the Anthropic red-team finding.
